tests.purpose: Test whether the PIR transistor output reaches PIC RC3 through hidden routing. Candidate only; no direct connection is assumed.
Test the other selected digital GPIO candidate, PIC RC7. If neither pair is low-ohm, both candidates are rejected.

interpretation: A reading near the shorted-probe baseline supports a direct connection. A kiloohm/megaohm reading or OL rejects a direct wire for that pair; do not turn a finite-resistance path into a net merge. Neither pair is connected in the model pending results. These checks address E07/E06 and may resolve a functional gap without reducing ERC by themselves.

next_stages.work: Agent completes visible copper tracing, removes unsupported assumptions and checks via matches. Priorities: receiver output, Q2/TP16 onward route, RF excitation, tuning-cell topology and the switch contact ambiguity. Only unresolved hidden destinations or behavior will be sent for targeted measurements.

Use the LCR meter for frequency-sensitive antenna, RF shaping and receiver capacitors first. In-circuit parallel networks give effective values; isolate a lead only if needed for individual values. L1/L2 type and value also remain unresolved. Use documented assumptions for noncritical substitutions where justified, not a blanket capacitor value.

Remove question marks only when replaced by established information or an explicit justified assumption. Run native KiCad connectivity/ERC and inspect the final sheet. Exact unknown manufacturer identity can remain documented without blocking a compatible functional reconstruction.

batch_title: Next: find the PIR signal route to the PIC
instructions: Keep one probe on R (TP16). Measure to S (TP11), then T (TP17). TP16 already reaches Q2 on visible copper. TP11 and TP17 already reach PIC pins 14/RC3 and 18/RC7 respectively. Their onward routes are unresolved: these two digital GPIO nodes are functional candidates for the PIR return, not photo-proven connections or an exhaustive list. The photos of both board faces do not establish either hidden link. Report actual resistance, even when it is high.
result_summary: B16 C-P and B17 C-Q each read 1 ohm. R23 right, C40 lower and R42 upper are one node. R23.2 is now connected in the schematic; C40 has been removed from the old inferred C23/R25 output grouping. Earlier high-resistance exclusions are retained.
